purpose: Prevent historical holdout reuse from being misrepresented as fresh predictive evidence after many MetaPleno generations have inspected 2023-2026.

requirements: ticket or policy frozen before target draw result exists
all real stakes and theoretical stakes logged
no additional overlapping tickets added after seeing partial evidence

note: Historical ROI and p-values remain useful research diagnostics, but final promotion requires new prospective evidence after this policy takes effect.
